freeTierSummary.zh-CN: API-Inference 改为「魔粒」积分制：每天签到领 200 魔粒、绑定阿里云账号再得 50（24 小时有效）；轻量模型 0.5 魔粒/次、主流 1 魔粒/次、旗舰 2 魔粒/次，约折合每天 125–500 次调用，需绑定阿里云账号并完成实名认证。
freeTierSummary.en: API-Inference now runs on 魔粒 (Magicube) credits: 200/day for signing in plus 50 for linking an Alibaba Cloud account (valid 24h); light models 0.5/call, standard 1/call, flagship 2/call — roughly 125–500 calls/day. Requires a linked, real-name-verified Alibaba Cloud account.
